corrections.note: Subject of 'fühlt', agrees with 'der fremde scheue': nominative singular.
Impersonal subject of 'träuft' once 'golden' is no longer read as subject.
Adverbially used adjective modifying 'träuft', not a subjunctive verb form.
'von ihm' modifies 'träuft'; an adverbial adjective does not take this PP.
Lemma 'träufen'; the 'wie' clause is the clausal object of 'fühlt'.
Nominalised adjective in the plural (subject of 'hätten'), not a proper name.
